venues.notes: Our home. Also the home ground of Broadfields United (groundshare).

GROUNDSHARE. Broadfields play at OUR ground. When Broadfields are the home team we are officially AWAY (isHome:false — away kit, away dressing room, away designation) but the VENUE is still Tithe Farm, so there is NO TRAVEL. 'Away' = designation; 'venue' = physical location. They are independent — never infer the venue from isHome.
